cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: A MobileNetV3-small image model runs on the CPU through ONNX to classify a photo of a crop leaf. The predicted crop and disease are added to the retrieval query and the prompt, so the language model's advice comes from the matching KALRO and Infonet reference text instead of from the model's own memory. A photo of a diseased maize leaf pulls the relevant maize guidance and returns an answer with its sources shown.

test_prompts.prompt: I'm a smallholder farmer in Machakos County growing maize on a sandy-loam plot. My plants are at the young whorl (knee-high) stage and I've found caterpillars boring into the stems with "windowpane" holes on the leaves. How can I control stem borer without using expensive pesticides?

Mimi ni mkulima mdogo katika Kaunti ya Nakuru ninayelima maharagwe kwenye udongo wa tifutifu. Maharagwe yangu yako katika hatua ya kutoa maua, na nimeona madoa ya kutu ya rangi ya kahawia-nyekundu kwenye majani. Ninawezaje kudhibiti kutu bila kutumia dawa za gharama kubwa, na ni nafasi gani inayofaa kupanda maharagwe?
